headline: Gold rebounds ₹261 today after a sharp fall; silver flat at ₹1,65,000/kg
summary: 24K gold is ₹12,589 per gram, up ₹261 (about 2.12%) from yesterday's ₹12,328, which was the lowest in the last 32 days. Over the past week gold has fallen about 3.67%, and since 26 October it is down about 11.81%, though it peaked at ₹14,602 on 5 November. Silver is unchanged today at ₹1,65,000 per kg, but is down 8.33% over seven days and 25% since 26 October. Likely drivers include international gold and silver prices, the US dollar against the rupee, and import duty, with festive and wedding buying possibly adding to local demand.
outlook: Today's bounce is a single-day move, so if you are buying jewellery or coins, compare the 22K and 24K rates at your own jeweller and budget for GST and making charges before deciding.
